notes_for_editor: Only Kamstra's page gives a build year (1915), a location and the 1939 abandonment; the other sources give agency, county and a Ground/Gone listing. Name collision: a backcountry retreat called Yellow Mule Cabin (built 1920, ~8,650 ft, per Trout & Trails; the page also says the cabin is eligible for NRHP nomination) is a different-looking structure, but no source links it to this lookout; the story warns visitors not to confuse them. Brief's location conflict unresolved: FFLA 45.1845, -111.41634 vs west_us_lookouts 45.2033, -111.4066 (not checked). Forest Lookouts gives township 7S-2E-36, not used. No photos, no staffing, no fire records found. Access and today's condition are unknown: brief access 'unknown' kept.
